chain_focus: AI-enabled drug discovery, precision medicine, autonomous laboratories, and the omics data platforms that feed biological models. AI security and trusted compute: the silicon, appliances and services that protect AI models, data and infrastructure. Security silicon (TPMs, platform roots of trust, root-of-trust FPGAs, OpenTitan / Caliptra RoT and the IP behind them), hardware security modules inside hyperscale clouds, confidential computing on GPUs and CPUs (NVIDIA Confidential Computing, AMD SEV-SNP, Intel TDX) and the confidential-AI software built on it, through server makers, hyperscalers and neoclouds, up to cybersecurity platforms that are themselves consumers of AI compute (CrowdStrike, Palo Alto Networks, Cloudflare, Akamai).

AMD Instinct MI355X (CDNA4) generation — the current-shipping Instinct accelerator on HBM3E and TSMC N3/CoWoS, deployed across cloud/enterprise/sovereign/supercomputing customers (Microsoft, Oracle, Meta) via ODMs. Prior generation to MI450/Helios (which moves to HBM4 + rack-scale); separated so the MI355X->MI450 transition delta is visible.

AMD Instinct MI450 / Helios rack-scale generation (CDNA, HBM4) — from fab tools and HBM4 through TSMC N2/N3 fabrication and CoWoS/SoIC packaging to the Helios rack (Instinct MI450 GPU + EPYC Venice CPU, Ethernet/UALink scale-out) and its anchor customers Meta (6GW multi-gen deal), OpenAI, Microsoft and Oracle. Generation-separated from the prior MI300/MI355X lineage.

AWS Trainium2 generation (Annapurna Labs design, HBM3E, 400G optical scale-out at ~1:4 attach) — vertically integrated from fab tools and HBM3E through TSMC fabrication, ASIC co-design partners (Marvell, Alchip) and CoWoS packaging to the Trainium2 UltraServer (NeuronLink scale-up, EFA/Nitro) deployed in AWS for its anchor AI-lab customer Anthropic (Project Rainier). Graviton (Arm) is the host CPU. Generation-separated from the future Trainium3.

AWS Trainium3 generation (Annapurna Labs design) — successor to Trainium2 on a more advanced TSMC node with HBM4 and copper+optical scale-out. Vertically integrated through Marvell/Alchip co-design, CoWoS packaging and Graviton (Arm) host to the Trainium3 UltraServer deployed in AWS for Anthropic. Forward-looking: limited grounded data until a dedicated AWS/Amazon or Marvell-Trainium transcript arrives.

AI compute and connectivity in and through space: orbital data centers (SpaceX Starmind, Google Project Suncatcher, Starcloud, Axiom Space, Sophia Space, Cowboy Space) built on space-grade AI compute (NVIDIA Space-1 Vera Rubin / IGX Thor / Jetson Orin, AMD XQR Versal) and radiation-hardened semiconductors, with AWS as the cloud for satellite data; the LEO connectivity and backhaul they depend on (Starlink, Amazon Leo, AST SpaceMobile, Kepler optical relay) with optical inter-satellite links, satellite RF / timing / connectivity components, RF foundries, RF test, PCBs and compound-semiconductor materials; satellite manufacturing and launch (Falcon 9 / Starship, New Glenn, Vulcan, Ariane 6, Electron / Neutron) with their booster, engine, propulsion-gas and cryogenic suppliers; and space solar power.

Google TPU v8i (inference) generation — the inference-optimized v8 SKU: leaner HBM4 capacity, no OCS scale-up, efficiency-focused serving. Host CPU migrates from x86 to custom Arm Axion 2. From fab tools and HBM4 through TSMC fabrication, Broadcom co-design and CoWoS packaging to inference-serving racks for Gemini and Anthropic in Google Cloud. Workload-separated from the training SKU TPU v8t (which carries far more HBM and optical/OCS content per unit — the key investment delta).

Google TPU v8t (training) generation — the training-optimized v8 SKU with high HBM4 capacity and heavy optical/OCS scale-up interconnect. Host CPU migrates from x86 to custom Arm Axion 2. From fab tools and HBM4 through TSMC fabrication, Broadcom co-design and CoWoS packaging to OCS-interconnected training pods serving Google DeepMind (Gemini training) and Anthropic. Generation- and workload-separated from TPU v7 (Ironwood) and the inference SKU TPU v8i.
